release_name: One-way Stage 1 numeric release for the multi-stage battery CCA-v2 experiment
forbidden_access: every archive whose frozen stage is 2
all CU, exCU, ZYK, ET_T10, ET_T45, AT_T10, and AT_T45 numeric data rows
any Stage 2 capacity, resistance, lifetime, trajectory, stopping, or high-performing-condition value
success_rule: All 141 Stage 1 archives must be accounted for. Evaluable cells pass the frozen archive hash, unique ET_T23/AT_T23 mapping, 23-degree metadata, step-type block, time, current, and positive-capacity checks. A frozen extractor validity failure is retained as endpoint-missing without substitution. Completion requires zero download, hash, or infrastructure errors.
failure_rule: No failing cell, file, step, temperature, endpoint, source, or target may be substituted. A protocol change requires a new disclosed amendment and cannot inspect Stage 2 outcomes.
next_seal: After complete Stage 1 extraction, freeze source models, Stage 2 outer splits, source predictions, applicability fields, and at least one calendar plus one cycle hypothesis card before any Stage 2 numeric row is opened.
claim_guard: Stage 1 outcomes are source-development information, not target evidence. They may generate models and hypotheses but cannot establish OOD improvement, transfer, discovery, or experiments saved until the still-sealed Stage 2 test is executed.
